# PixiJS 3D

`pixi-3d-0.1.0-beta.2.tgz` is the MIT-licensed `@pixi/3d` library distribution
already used by Nixie, sourced from https://github.com/pixijs/pixi-3d.
The distribution includes its LICENSE and source maps. This exact artifact is
retained here because the beta is not available from the public npm registry.
It contains renderer code, not Foxhole assets. FoxWatch installs it locally and
requires no Nixie checkout. Its SHA-256 is recorded in `config/source-media.json`.
